test: DEV-ATLAS-USE-02 (ATL-067): atlas v2.1 head to head against Loyfer's own reference
sealed: 2026-10-16, before Loyfer's projected reference is built or any of its values read
job: for the jobs a reference atlas is used for (markers that hold, reading mixtures, and cells the reference lacks), is v2.1 at least as good as Loyfer's own reference
opponent: Loyfer et al. 2023 (Nature 613:355), his 205 samples (GEO GSE186458) in his 39 groups (his Supplementary Table S1), projected onto array probes as his paper does: wgbstools beta_to_450k (coverage >= 3), mean per group

bars.UT2A: v2.1 median mixture error <= 1.5 x Loyfer's (shared ground)
bars.UT2B: v2.1 median mixture error <= 0.5 x Loyfer's (wide area)

verdict: all three met: v2.1 commissioned against Loyfer's reference on these jobs (showcase, as the Moss run); otherwise reported as is
disclosures: v2.1 was built from Loyfer's sequencing plus public arrays, so it contains his data; the question is whether the combined atlas reads held-out arrays better than his reference does
Loyfer pools CD4 and CD8 T cells (Blood-T), so both atlases use one T-cell profile; v2.1's is the mean of its CD4 and CD8 profiles
Loyfer's Blood-Mono+Macro pools monocytes and macrophages
the held-out arrays were read before in U1 and in the Moss head-to-head; Loyfer's projected reference has never been built or read
his published 450K marker list (Supplementary Table S12, 936 probes) is reported for reference; the scored markers come from the sealed rule applied to each reference alike
